sql: SELECT w.* FROM main."Wells" w WHERE w."water_depth" > CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AND w."geometry" IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(w."geometry") AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main."Pipelines" p WHERE p."current_phase" = ? AND p."geometry" IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(p."geometry") AND ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(w."geometry", 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3035', always_xy := TRUE), ST_Transform(p."geometry", 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3035', always_xy := TRUE), CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION)))
interpretation: metadata → knowledge/datasets; source files are hashed
depth → Wells.water_depth: Water depth at the well location, in meters.
distance → EPSG:3035 planar meters, longitude/latitude axis order
within distance is inclusive; relation uses EXISTS, returning each well once
